metadata.grid_source: jeju_grid_500m in radar_grid_cells.gpkg: official KMA radar composite grid (LCC 30/60, 126E/38N, WGS84 ellipsoid, i0=1121/j0=1681), every 500m cell touching the Natural Earth 1:10m Jeju outline
metadata.coverage_note: Cells are selected by intersection with a small-scale (1:10m) coastline, so coastal cells contain water and some small islets or coastal strips may be excluded. Water pixels carry near-zero DSM heights and slopes; they are not land terrain statistics.
